Python with function docstring, verify docstring count

```ruby title="Ruby"

result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def greet(name):\n    \"\"\"Say hello to someone.\"\"\"\n    return f\"Hello {name}\"\n", { 'docstrings' => true, 'language' => 'python' })
```
